# slackapp_installation (Resource)

Experimental native installation of an owned bot app in a standalone or Enterprise workspace. Requires a Slack CLI service token scoped to that exact workspace. Uses the CLI's developer APIs, whose compatibility and account access must be verified before deployment. Create requires confirmed absence; import an existing installation instead. Scope/domain changes reinstall; deleting this resource uninstalls the app, without deleting its definition. Organization-wide installation and third-party installation are unsupported. Use lifecycle.prevent_destroy where uninstall requires review.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `bot_scopes` (Set of String) Requested bot scopes for install/reinstall. These are inputs, not an attestation of existing token grants.
- `workspace_id` (String)

### Optional

- `outgoing_domains` (Set of String) Outgoing domains passed to install/reinstall.

### Read-Only

- `app_level_token` (String, Sensitive) App-level token returned by install/reinstall. Sensitive state; not recoverable on read/import.
- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Bot token returned by install/reinstall. Sensitive state; not recoverable on read/import.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `installed` (Boolean) True after apps.status confirms installation. Null when an attempted mutation cannot be confirmed.
- `user_token` (String, Sensitive) User token returned by install/reinstall. Sensitive state; not recoverable on read/import.
